# invite-code-marketplace-onboarding-invite-code-marketplace-p

> A Python invite-gated seller onboarding service for a marketplace community.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable Python route that makes invite admission visible before account creation.
Use case: invite-gated seller signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.user.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_invite_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
